summons.text: Amara Okafor, Lagos... nice. Tomasz Wierzbicki, Kraków... nice. Mostly.
*He turns the page. The Naughty List goes on, and on.*
Nick. It's three in the morning.
The List doesn't read itself, Holly.
When did you last take a day off?

choice.text: Sixteen-ninety-something. Lovely Tuesday, as I recall.

then.text: That was a joke. Please tell me that was a joke.

choice.text: Christmas doesn't take days off. Neither do I.

then.text: Christmas has four hundred elves, Nick. You're allowed to use them.

choice.text: I'll take one when the world stops needing a List.

summons.caption: Somewhere in the workshop, a telephone rings.

summons.text: Sir! It's on your desk, sir. It's gold. I have never seen it before in my life.
Santa! Big fan. Huge fan. Probably the biggest fan you've ever had. I need you in Washington. Tonight.
Christmas is being stolen. Tremendous theft. The biggest theft, maybe ever.
You're the only one who can fix it. Well, you and me. But mostly you.

choice.text: Then let's save it together, Mr. President. What do you know?

then.text: I love the energy. Love it. Very few people have that energy.

choice.text: Stolen by whom? I'll need names.

then.text: Names. Tough. I like it. We have names, believe me.

choice.text: You flew me four thousand miles to tell me something I'd already noticed?

then.text: Funny. You're a funny guy. People don't say that about you, but you are.

summons.caption: He slides a gold folder across the desk. It is stamped DOSSIER, and it is very thick.

summons.text: Jack Frost... Krampus... Ebenezer Scrooge? These files are remarkably detailed.
Where does a government find this sort of thing in a single night?
We have people. The best people. Don't worry about it.

choice.text: Everyone on that list still deserves a Christmas. I'll bring it back.
If they're on the Naughty List, they'll answer for it.
Fine. But don't expect anything extra in your stocking.

jolly.text: Beautiful. That's what I said. Everybody's saying it now. Go get 'em.

stern.text: Tough on crime. Very strong. I've always said that. Go get 'em.

sardonic.text: Ha! Nobody gets more in their stocking than me. Nobody. Go get 'em.

summons.caption: Santa tucks the dossier under his arm, and the long night begins.
